title: Star of TV's Ghost Hunters appears in Glasgow, Kentucky
excerpt: Steve Gonsalves from TV’s Ghost Hunters and Ghost Nation, will be meeting fans at the Plaza Theatre in Glasgow, Kentucky Saturday September 12, 2026
content:
Steve Gonsalves from TV’s Ghost Hunters and Ghost Nation, will be meeting fans at the Plaza Theatre in Glasgow, Kentucky Saturday September 12, 2026

  • steve dark background

  • glasgow socials

Glasgow, Kentucky Sep 5, 2026 (Issuewire.com)  - Paranormal investigator, television personality, and bestselling author Steve Gonsalves has officially announced his highly anticipated national theater tour, Steve Gonsalves LIVE: A Life With Ghosts. Launching this fall,he will be on stage at the Plaza Theatre in Glasgow, KY Saturday, September 12, 2026. The multimedia live production promises to take audiences on an immersive, thought-provoking journey into the unexplained, drawing directly from Gonsalves’ twenty-plus years on the front lines of paranormal research.

Best known as the lead investigator on the hit television series Ghost Hunters and Ghost Nation, as well as the director of The House Inbetween, Gonsalves is stepping off the screen and onto the stage. A Life With Ghosts offers a rare, behind-the-scenes look into his extensive personal archives. The newly updated show blends historical details with firsthand case accounts, eerie audio and video captures, and exclusive, never-before-seen footage from his most famous and terrifying investigations.

Rather than relying solely on easy scares, the production leans into Gonsalves’ trademark intellectual curiosity and thoughtful skepticism, exploring the deep, often unsettling history of the locations he has investigated. The evening balances moments with humor, audience interaction, and a live, completely unfiltered audience Q&A session.

"I’ve spent more than two decades searching the dark for answers, and what I’ve learned is that the true history behind these haunted places is often just as gripping and unsettling as the encounters themselves," says Steve Gonsalves. "This tour isn't just about sharing the evidence we've caught on camera or microphone; it's about giving people an honest, up-close seat next to me as we pull back the curtain on a life spent in the unknown. I can't wait to get out there, share these new cases, and talk face-to-face with the fans who have been with me on this journey."

The tour will feature multiple ticketing tiers, including a highly exclusive VIP package. VIP ticket holders will receive early entry into the venue for an exclusive meet-and-greet photo opportunity with Steve, a collector’s hard-laminate badge and lanyard, a signed tour poster, and a signed copy of his bestselling book, A Life With Ghosts.

Tickets, VIP packages, and complete venue scheduling information are available now on the official tour website at SteveGLive.com.

About Steve Gonsalves:

Steve Gonsalves is a nationwide bestselling author, filmmaker, and one of the most recognized and trusted voices in the paranormal field. With massive global recognition spanning over fifteen seasons as a lead investigator on the cultural phenomenon Ghost Hunters, alongside Ghost Hunters Academy and Ghost Nation, Steve has helped pave the way for modern paranormal television. He is also the director and producer of the critically acclaimed documentary series The House Inbetween. His book, A Life With Ghosts, debuted as an instant bestseller, chronicling his historical insights and personal evolutionary journey through the supernatural world.
